extracted.name: Grilled Onions
extracted.description: Learn how to make perfectly grilled onions! I like to serve them as a side dish with other grilled veggies or as a topping for burgers or tacos. Find more serving suggestions in the post above.
ingredient_lines: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
instruction_lines: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium heat. In a medium bowl, toss the onions with drizzles of olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Grill the onions for 4 to 5 minutes per side, or until char marks form and the onions are tender.
